_doc: Diagnose the NEW ~1M-stream wall found by wal-stacked-1m (stacked ideal config: 383k @100k, 244k @500k, 56k @1M). Candidates: (a) one open fd per live stream vs the container nofile ceiling (~1.05M) — 1M streams sits right at it, the accept loop sheds on EMFILE; (b) ext4 streams/ directory with 1M files; (c) tails-map full rewrite per checkpoint (cumulative map = O(N_total) write); (d) post-setup settle: creating 1M streams leaves 1M dirty files + meta sidecars mid-writeback and the 12s warmup measured the storm, not steady state. This suite separates (d) from the rest via warmup_secs 90 (vs 12), and the launcher runs a telemetry capture loop (SRV_STATS / WAL_CKPT / WAL_CONT + live fd count of the server process every 15s -> results/wal-1m-diag/telemetry-<n>.log) to identify (a)/(b)/(c) directly. Same stacked config/image as wal-stacked-1m. If 1M with a long warmup recovers to ~200k+, the wall is mostly (d); if fd count plateaus at ~1.05M with appends collapsing, it is (a); WAL_CKPT fsync_us/cadence exposes (b)/(c). Requires STATIC_CPU=1 SPLITLANE=1 GUARANTEED=1 SERVER_LOCAL_SSD_BLOCK=1 SPOT_SERVER=1 BARRIER_SETUP_TIMEOUT_SECS=3600 IMG_SERVER=...:sizetrigger.
